items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: To me, I think the greatest tone I ever heard on the trombone was Jerry Shimmer. ... He was supposed to come down and see me.

ctx.x: So it was very similar to your tone.
To me, I think the greatest tone I ever heard on the trombone was Jerry Shimmer. Played with Susie, he was a teacher.
